card.name: Decimal digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, usually 3 or 5, right after a decimal point in a number such as 637.5 or 49.3, mostly before mg or mL in dosing tables and calculations.

modes.label: Tenths digit before a unit
modes.description: The digit after the decimal point in a dose or volume, followed by mg or mL.

modes.label: Digit in dose-table values
modes.description: The .5 ending in numbers listed in weight-based or dose-reduction tables.

card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a decimal dose number, such as the 5 in 37.5 mg.
